name: Pallof Press

instructions.description: Stand side-on to a securely anchored band and hold it at the chest.
Adopt a stable stance and gently brace the trunk.
Press the hands forward without allowing the torso to rotate.
Return the hands to the chest and repeat before changing sides.

variations.variationDescription: Pallof Press — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Pallof Press — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.

commentsNotes: Anchor the band securely at chest height.
